title: Toward Responsible Federated Large Language Models: Leveraging a Safety Filter and Constitutional AI

bias_targets.target: General Harmlessness and Toxicity (including hate speech and controversial statements)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the AdvBench benchmark via rule-based checks for harmful phrases in responses to red teaming prompts, and the HHH (Helpful, Honest, Harmless) benchmark via multiple-choice accuracy between safe and unsafe response options.

Addressed conceptually as a potential risk where everyday questions (e.g., election inquiries) act as unintentional red teaming prompts, evaluated broadly under the general safety and harmlessness benchmarks (SQuARe, AdvBench, HHH).

primary_bias_target: General Harmlessness and Toxicity (including hate speech and controversial statements)
